payload.chunk_text:
Let's Make a Solar Cooker!
YOU WILL NEED
. a large cardboard box . thermocol . aluminium foil . clear plastic wrap . a sheet of black paper . ruler . pair of scissors . glue . tape
1 Start by taking a cardboard box. Leaving an even margin of 2 cm on each side, draw a square on its lid.
2 Make a flap on the lid by cutting three sides of the square. Fold this flap out so that it stands up when the lid is closed.
3 Take five one-inch thick pieces of thermocol and stick them to the base and walls of the box so that they provide insulation.
4 Glue aluminium foil to all the thermocol pieces. The walls and base of the box should now have an even layer of aluminium foil on them.
5 Make the reflector by gluing a piece of aluminium foil to the inside of the flap.
6 Glue black paper to the base of the box.
7 Use a sheet of glass or clear plastic wrap to create an airtight window for sunlight to enter the box. Do this by taping the glass or plastic over the opening of the flap.
8 Open the lid carefully and place your food inside. Set the flap open in such a way that the foil reflects sunlight and directs it inside. Use a ruler or stick to support the flap. Your solar cooker is now ready!
